product.name: Pashmina-blend winter shawl
product.description: Mid-price pashmina-blend shawl in four colours for the winter wedding season.

rule_trace.description: Each unit sold earns a positive contribution
Cash is paid back within the owner's horizon (base case)
Chance of a loss over the horizon is within the limit
Monthly break-even volume is within plausible demand (p90 peak month)
Peak cash need fits the capital set aside
Chance of paying back within the horizon supports a full launch
Demand evidence comes from the product's own sales history

inputs.name: unit_cost
inputs.basis: Supplier quotation from sup_031 for 300+ units.

inputs.name: price
inputs.basis: Owner's proposed shelf price, GST included.

inputs.name: freight_per_unit
inputs.basis: Courier rate quoted by the supplier.

inputs.name: packaging_per_unit
inputs.basis: Gift box and tissue.

inputs.name: launch_costs
inputs.basis: Photoshoot, window display and first social campaign.

inputs.name: marketing_monthly
inputs.basis: Planned monthly social ads.

inputs.name: storage_cost_per_unit_month
inputs.basis: Share of back-room rent; verify.

inputs.name: demand_level_units_per_month
inputs.basis: Average monthly units of comparable wool shawls over the last 24 months.

inputs.name: demand_reference_price
inputs.basis: Average selling price of the comparable shawls.

inputs.name: seasonality_peak_index
inputs.basis: January index of comparable shawl sales; Nov-Feb carry 85% of the year.

inputs.name: price_elasticity_medium
inputs.basis: No price experiments in the ledger; medium-sensitivity scenario from the rulebook.

inputs.name: discount_rate
inputs.basis: Average discount on shawls last winter.

inputs.name: payment_fee_rate
inputs.basis: Card and QR settlement fees as a share of shawl takings.

inputs.name: return_rate
inputs.basis: Refunded share of comparable shawl sales.

inputs.name: return_loss_rate
inputs.basis: Share of returned shawls that cannot be resold; verify.

inputs.name: wastage_rate
inputs.basis: Transit damage allowance.

inputs.name: unsold_recovery_rate
inputs.basis: Apparel industry pack: unsold seasonal stock clears at 40% of cost.

inputs.name: moq
inputs.basis: Supplier minimum order.

inputs.name: lead_time_days
inputs.basis: Supplier lead time.

inputs.name: available_capital
inputs.basis: Cash the owner has set aside for this product.

data_gaps.impact: Small: under 1% of contribution in the base case.
data_gaps.question: Roughly how much of your back-room rent should a box of shawls carry each month?

limitations: This product has no sales history of its own; demand is modelled from comparable products and stated assumptions, not trained on the product's own data.
Probabilities come from a simulation of the stated assumptions. They are not calibrated real-world probabilities.
Demand response to marketing spend is not modelled; use a what-if with a demand change to explore it.
Price elasticity could not be estimated from the ledger, so pricing uses three explicit elasticity scenarios.
